source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.2, printed pages 266-270.

blocks.text: Skeletal system bohat si bimariyon (disorders) ka shikar ho sakta hai jo us ki banawat aur kaam par asar dalti hain. Yeh bimariyan skeletal system ke kisi bhi hisse ko mutasir kar sakti hain, maslan haddiyan, jor (joints) aur connective tissues.
